svg.aria-label: The reflexer engine flow: a typed decision request line is decoded fail-closed, ONE frozen-genome search answers every question in the request — place by canonical argmax, state by sigmoid onto a five-level rubric, survive by legal-placement existence — confidence read by the inherited dispatch, and one envelope line answers with the genome and in-engine decision time; unknown questions abstain structurally and malformed lines answer typed errors with the pipe staying alive
